verdicts.reason: A: the left edges don't line up. The logo and headline start at ~88px, the subcopy at ~70px and the second pill row at ~106px. The CTA floats off to the right, the pills are staggered over two rows with no clear logic, and there is a slightly loose gap above the pills. Still, the vertical spacing uses the canvas reasonably and the hierarchy holds. B has the same ragged subcopy and pill-row edges and adds a third: Blood Orange starts at ~65px, out of line with everything else. The CTA is pushed hard to the right and the pills are jammed right under it, leaving ~80px of dead space at the bottom, so the layout is top-heavy and less intentional than A.
